caption: The drawing shows a single ceramic cup centered on a plain, light background. The cup is conical, wider at the top and narrower at the base, and is depicted in shades of brown, beige, and ochre. It features a decorative pattern with yellow and brown leaves and curled tendrils, accented with some areas of green. The cup’s inner rim is brown, with shading suggesting light is coming from the left. There are no additional objects in the image. The drawing is signed with the name "Albert Lemoine" in small script to the lower right of the cup.
title: Pa. German Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
